box.scope: Full physics step; no rendering, file recording, diagnostics, or reset. Synchronized wall-clock latency.
box.warmup: One complete rollout before measurements; every repeat starts from the same recorded state.
box.stage_scope: CUDA events in a separate rollout; may include launch gaps; do not interpret as pure kernel duration.
box.contact_method: Parallel relaxed Jacobi, same unilateral/Coulomb equations; unrelaxed impulse residual < 1e-9 N s.

transfer_audit.note: Warp HashGrid.build uploads its 88-byte configuration descriptor; particle/body state and solver decisions remain on GPU.

sphere.contact_method: Relaxed Jacobi; same unilateral/Coulomb equations; unrelaxed impulse residual < 1e-9 N s.
